findings.rationale: This classical asymmetric primitive relies on factoring or discrete logarithms, which are vulnerable to a sufficiently capable quantum computer. findings.recommendation: Plan supported ML-KEM or a standardized hybrid key-establishment protocol; assess signatures separately.

score.label: Project quantum exposure heuristic (0–100; higher means more exposure)
